policy_amendments.name: positive-input-minimum-monetary-cost
policy_amendments.description: Positive entry price and Gratis load produce at least one reference-currency minor unit; the independent reference includes this policy.
policy_amendments.expected_source: Exact integer arithmetic: floor(1 * 1 / 1000000) is clamped to 1; Gratis load remains 1.

policy_amendments.name: entry-derived-nod-floor
policy_amendments.description: A Nod action carries the observed entry price, from which its floor derives; the tribute price does not enter it.
policy_amendments.expected_source: The action carries the observed entry price 3000000 with a tribute price of 4000000; its cost is floor(3000000 * 32000000 / 1000000) = 96000000.
